purpose: Test whether pre-pooling 12x12 V-JEPA detail moments contain complementary activity information that is absent from the retained 3x3 representation.

anchor.name: ARFTR
anchor.action_boundary: ARFTR is unchanged and is never overwritten by this probe

population.split: locked scenario/recording grouped folds from memory_data.npz
population.training_labels: center labels from outer-training rows only

inputs.time_contract: tubelet midpoint = mean of each consecutive pair in source_frames; centered on metadata frame at nominal 30 fps
inputs.quality: six observable geometry/validity values from memory_data, standardized from outer-training rows only

representation.coarse_control: repeat each retained 3x3 token into its corresponding 4x4 block; pass the same 3x3 tensor as coarse_reference
representation.fine_candidate: genuine retained 12x12 tokens with the identical 3x3 coarse_reference

training.loss: center-label cross-entropy with inverse-square-root outer-training class weights, normalized to mean one
training.selection: no inner selection; all architecture and optimizer values frozen before outer fitting
training.shuffle: deterministic torch permutation seed + fold + arm index
training.normalization: per-channel mean/std from outer-training coarse tokens, reused for fine and repeated-coarse inputs; epsilon 1e-5

evaluation.primary: standalone fine_both versus matched coarse_control macro-F1 on outer-held rows
evaluation.blend: descriptive arithmetic mean only; no weight or threshold selection
evaluation.promotion: not authorized in this probe; any ARFTR integration requires a fresh nested inner-OOF protocol

advance_to_nested_integration: fine_both beats coarse_control by at least 0.005 macro-F1
fine_both has positive standalone delta in at least 4/5 outer folds
fine_both contributes at least 25 unique ARFTR-error rescues with no more than 1.5 harms/rescue
fixed blend is not worse than ARFTR by more than 0.002 macro-F1
no class F1 falls by more than 0.01 versus coarse_control
go_no_go.close_branch: if the primary contrast fails; do not widen ranks, epochs, seeds, or matching modes in this branch
go_no_go.note: These are development gates for deciding whether a properly nested ARFTR-preserving integration is worth the next compute budget, not a deployable claim.

leakage_controls: outer-held labels are never indexed during optimizer updates
normalization and class weights use outer-training labels/statistics only
ARFTR probabilities are read only after all candidate fits for fixed-blend diagnostics
no support purity, annotation-derived category, human-review field, scenario identity, or track identity enters the model
checkpoint and probability replay must match exact sample IDs and fold membership

compute_boundary.timing_smoke: one fold, one arm, one epoch, 8 rows; no scientific score
compute_boundary.full_probe: 20 fixed outer fits, 8 epochs, projected below 20 minutes; stop if projection exceeds 20 minutes
